method.frequency: One explicit MCP tool-call record = one call, including errors/retries. Mentions and code examples are excluded. Repeated calls are retained. Official API calls are separate from Native calls.
method.response_measure: Visible exported text only; missing responses and image tokens are excluded, not assigned zero costs. Arguments measured as compact JSON separately.
method.generalization: Selected task threads, not a production usage distribution. Old skill/version and capability availability confound zero counts.
method.cache_frequency: Cache artifacts deduplicate payloads, span unrelated research runs, and are not invocation logs. Never added to call frequencies.
method.counterfactual: Same recorded responses, task-specific projections only; no assumed reduction in call count, no performance claim. Missing responses remain unknown.
